title: The pad on the nail
logline: The receipt pad on its nail by the tavern's back door, from the alley side — the page can't see it; it draws the nail's head through the wall, a dot, and the gap under the door where the envelopes go. Twenty years of rent.

panels.composition: A tavern's back door from the alley at dusk: a bare bulb, the gap under the door with an envelope's corner showing, and a small drawn dot on the wall where a nail's head would be on the other side.
